column1: # The in-guest toolchain scenario (`.notes/toolchain_in_os.md` Phases 2, 3 and 4).
# Driven by `just test-toolchain-<arch>`, on a disk image whose root is the staged
# tree from `cargo xtask build llvm-minix`. `/usr/bin/clang` is a wrapper: the
# driver is `/usr/libexec/clang-driver`, and the wrapper is what knows the headers,
# the linker, the script, `crt0.o`, the archives and the image bases. So a `-c`
# line and a link line are both exercised, and the run steps can only pass if the
# linked program is a working one (the wrapper also makes it executable, which is
# `--version` answers with the driver's banner, whose first line carries the
# version; the rest of the line is the build's own (a packaged clang prints its
# Every compile is followed by a `wc -c` of its output: an empty expectation would

# The C++ steps are the C ones through `clang++`, and `hello.cpp` is

# unless libc++ and libc++abi were staged and linked whole. The three `cxx/*.cpp`
# units cover the libc++ headers whose search order the wrapper has to get right.
